projects.title: matchday-jersey-store
projects.desc: MatchDay is a self-contained .html storefront template for jersey and fan-gear shops. There's no framework, no build step, and no backend — open the file in a browser and it works. Every team, product, banner, and price lives in one editable config block at the top of the file, so a store owner can re-skin the entire shop without touching markup.
